Graph comes from Brand & Premchitt (1980).

Where a piezometer tip is surrounded by a granular filter material,
it is the dimensions of this filter which should be used to derive
values of F.

Where L is large compared with D, the test will tend to measure
the horizontal permeability of the soil.

Where the horizontal permeability of the soil is much greater
than the vertical, the test will measure the former, whatever
the relation between L and D.
